name: Risk Readiness (Schubert)
description: Schubert's risk readiness questionnaire shows how willing you are to take risks and how necessary and sensible those risks are. It can also point to the causes of everyday mistakes and help you adjust your behaviour to achieve more with less effort.
instruction: Rate how ready you would be to do each of the things you are asked about.

1.text: Would you break the speed limit to get a seriously ill person to medical help faster?

2.text: Would you join a long, dangerous expedition for good pay?

3.text: Would you step into the path of a dangerous burglar who is running away?

4.text: Could you ride on the step of a freight wagon travelling at over 100 km/h?

5.text: Can you work normally the day after a sleepless night?

6.text: Would you be the first to wade across very cold water?

7.text: Would you lend a friend a large sum of money without being sure they could pay it back?

8.text: Would you go into a lion's cage with the tamer if they assured you it was safe?

9.text: Could you climb a tall factory chimney if someone guided you from below?

10.text: Could you sail a boat without any training?

11.text: Would you risk grabbing the bridle of a galloping horse?

12.text: Could you ride a bike after 10 glasses of beer?

13.text: Could you do a parachute jump?

14.text: If you had to, could you travel a long distance by train without a ticket?

15.text: Would you go on a road trip if the driver was an acquaintance who had recently been in a serious crash?

16.text: Could you jump from a height of 10 metres onto a fire brigade's safety net?

17.text: To get rid of a long illness that keeps you in bed, would you have a life-threatening operation?

18.text: Could you jump off the step of a freight wagon moving at 50 km/h?

19.text: As an exception, would you ride in a lift built for six people together with seven others?

20.text: For a large cash reward, would you cross a busy intersection blindfolded?

21.text: Would you take a life-threatening job if it paid well?

22.text: Could you calculate percentages after 10 shots of vodka?

23.text: Would you take hold of a high-voltage cable on your manager's instruction if they assured you it was switched off?

24.text: Could you fly a helicopter after a short briefing?

25.text: Could you make a long train journey with a ticket but no food?

summaries.Испытуемый слишком осторожен и не готов: Overly cautious and not ready to take risks
summaries.Испытуемый больше готов к риску, чем нет: More ready to take risks than not
summaries.Испытуемый не осторожен и полностью гото: Not cautious and fully ready to take risks
